description: An operator runs fictional version A; its completed snapshot creates only added records and becomes current.
Version B is compared to version A and exposes added, changed, and removed records.
Re-running the same fictional source version does not duplicate a snapshot or change records.
An invalid fictional payload produces a safe failed run and cannot change the current list.
A viewer receives 403 when attempting to run a watchlist update but can read the current list.
The console describes watchlist operations and workspace access while keeping the fictional-data indicator visible.
